evidence.note: NIST provides a threat-modeling definition and security-engineering context.

claims.statement: Threat modeling identifies assets, trust boundaries, threats, and mitigations during system design and review.

evidence.note: NIST defines least privilege as restricting access to the minimum necessary.

claims.statement: Least privilege limits an identity, process, or workload to the access required for an authorized task.

evidence.note: The official reference describes host discovery and service/version detection capabilities.

claims.statement: Nmap is used for network discovery and service enumeration in authorized environments.

evidence.note: The official project site describes ZAP as a web application security scanner and proxy.

claims.statement: OWASP ZAP is an open-source web application security testing proxy.

evidence.note: CWE-89 documents the improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command.

claims.statement: SQL injection occurs when untrusted input changes the intended structure of a database query.
